svg.title: How the assistant fits together
svg.desc: You chat on your phone with a Telegram bot, and the official channel plugin connects it to a Claude Code session that runs in tmux, in auto mode, on your Claude subscription, on an always-on machine of yours, set up as you like. Voice notes are turned into text on arrival (Groq, then Cloudflare, then a local engine). The session reads and writes CLAUDE.md, its notes and memory, uses a full browser with a remote window, the devices you allow (TV, media server, over your network or Tailscale) and, optionally, a limited card, and uses the Gmail, Calendar and Drive connectors of claude.ai. Hooks on every tool call send its status and permission buttons to Telegram. A nightly cycle saves the day, reviews memory, updates and restarts it. Optionally, n8n alerts you directly when nothing needs thinking (page watches), and otherwise hands a one-line notice to the wake-up, which types it into the session (new email, a new release of the assistant); the session builds n8n workflows through MCP.
svg.text: OPTIONAL · NO TOKENS UNTIL SOMETHING HAPPENS
a container, a VM, a plain user or root: your call
